description: This file contains command definitions and handler functions for user management in the Mattermost CLI, including user creation, activation, deactivation, editing, deletion, and preferences management.

methods.name: userActivateCmdF
methods.description: Handles user activation command execution.

methods.name: userActivateCompletionF
methods.description: Provides completion suggestions for user activation command.

methods.name: changeUsersActiveStatus
methods.description: Changes activation status for multiple users.

methods.name: changeUserActiveStatus
methods.description: Changes activation status for a single user.

methods.name: userDeactivateCmdF
methods.description: Handles user deactivation command execution.

methods.name: userDeactivateCompletionF
methods.description: Provides completion suggestions for user deactivation command.

methods.name: userCreateCmdF
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified parameters.

methods.name: userInviteCmdF
methods.description: Sends an invite to a user for specified teams.

methods.name: inviteUser
methods.description: Invites a user to a team.

methods.name: sendPasswordResetEmailCmdF
methods.description: Sends password reset emails to specified users.

methods.name: changePasswordUserCmdF
methods.description: Changes a user's password.

methods.name: resetUserMfaCmdF
methods.description: Resets MFA for a user.

methods.name: deleteUsersCmdF
methods.description: Deletes specified users.

methods.name: deleteAllUsersCmdF
methods.description: Deletes all users (local command).

methods.name: searchUserCmdF
methods.description: Searches for users based on criteria.

methods.name: listUsersCmdF
methods.description: Lists users with pagination and filters.

methods.name: verifyUserEmailWithoutTokenCmdF
methods.description: Verifies user email without token.

methods.name: userConvertCmdF
methods.description: Converts users to bots or bots to users.

methods.name: convertUserToBot
methods.description: Converts a user to a bot.

methods.name: convertBotToUser
methods.description: Converts a bot to a user.

methods.name: migrateAuthCmdF
methods.description: Handles authentication provider migration.

methods.name: migrateAuthToSamlCmdF
methods.description: Migrates accounts to SAML.

methods.name: migrateAuthToLdapCmdF
methods.description: Migrates accounts to LDAP.

methods.name: promoteGuestToUserCmdF
methods.description: Promotes guest users to regular users.

methods.name: demoteUserToGuestCmdF
methods.description: Demotes users to guests.

methods.name: userEditCompletionF
methods.description: Provides completion suggestions for user editing.

methods.name: userEditCmdF
methods.description: Edits user fields like username, email, authdata.

methods.name: preferencesListCmdF
methods.description: Lists user preferences.

methods.name: preferencesGetCmdF
methods.description: Gets a specific user preference.

methods.name: preferencesUpdateCmdF
methods.description: Updates a user preference.

methods.name: preferencesDeleteCmdF
methods.description: Deletes a user preference.
